english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a numerical or statistical average, especially before a noun such as age.

examples.english: The average age of this class is eighteen.
examples.traditional: 呢班學生嘅平均年齡係十八歲。
examples.jyutping: nei1 baan1 hok6 saang1 ge3 ping4 gwan1 nin4 ling4 hai6 sap6 baat3 seoi3

english.note: Use this when amounts, sizes, or proportions are distributed equally.

examples.english: The company will split the bonus into even shares for everyone.
examples.traditional: 公司將獎金平均分畀大家。
examples.jyutping: gung1 si1 zoeng1 zoeng2 gam1 ping4 gwan1 fan1 bei2 daai6 gaa1
